title: Make sprint close enforce unresolved descendant work
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk sprint close refuses to close when sprint metrics report unresolved descendant work, unless an explicit force path with reason/comment is implemented.
Runtime or CLI closeout policy cannot bypass unresolved child blockers through direct sprint close.
Regression tests cover unresolved descendant work, carryover/defer behavior, and normal all-closed sprint closeout.
Workflow docs explain how to defer, carry over, or force a sprint close with an auditable reason.
closedReason: fresh unresolved-descendant sprint close validation passed
